# Java Edition protocol/Slot data

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.20.6`  
> Protocol version: `766`  
> Source: [Java Edition protocol/Slot data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Slot_data?oldid=2768623)  
> Revision: `2768623` (`2024-02-24T23:08:35Z`)  
> Retrieved: `2026-08-04T16:00:27+00:00`  
> License: [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)

The **Slot** data structure is how Minecraft represents an item and its associated data in the [Minecraft Protocol](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol "Protocol").

### Slot

| Name | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Present | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | True if there is an item in this position; false if it is empty. |
| Item ID | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Omitted if present is false. The [Template:Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Template:Minecraft_Wiki?action=edit&redlink=1 "Template:Minecraft Wiki (page does not exist)"). Item IDs are distinct from block IDs; see [Data Generators](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_Generators?action=edit&redlink=1 "Data Generators (page does not exist)") for more information |
| Item Count | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Byte](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Byte "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Omitted if present is false. |
| NBT | [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:NBT "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Omitted if present is false. If 0 (TAG\_End), there is no NBT data, and no further data follows. Otherwise the byte is the start of an NBT blob as shown below: |

```
  COMPOUND
    LIST 'StoredEnchantments'
      COMPOUND
        STRING 'id'
        SHORT 'lvl'
      END
      COMPOUND
        ...
      END
      ...
    END
    INT 'Unbreakable'
    ...
  END
```

Note that on old versions, the enchantment id was sent as a SHORT, and not as a STRING.

Since 1.20.2 the root compound also has no name anymore. The NBT data starts with one byte indicating the type, followed by the type-specific data.

See [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/NBT "NBT") for more information about the NBT format, and [Template:Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Template:Minecraft_Wiki?action=edit&redlink=1 "Template:Minecraft Wiki (page does not exist)") for the contained information and its format. Note that tool durability is included in NBT, among other things.

## Examples

```
  00                      | empty slot
  01 01 01 00             | a stone block
  01 01 01 03 12 34 56 78 | a stone block with (made-up) NBT data
```
